name: Securities Option 117
definition: Provides information about the corporate action security option.

SecurityDetails.name: Security Details
SecurityDetails.definition: Provides description of the financial instrument related to securities movement.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the value is a debit or credit.

TemporaryFinancialInstrumentIndicator.name: Temporary Financial Instrument Indicator
TemporaryFinancialInstrumentIndicator.definition: Specifies that the security identified is a temporary security identification used for processing reasons, for example, contra security used in the US.

NonEligibleProceedsIndicator.name: Non Eligible Proceeds Indicator
NonEligibleProceedsIndicator.definition: Specifies information regarding outturn resources that cannot be processed by the Central Securities Depository (CSD). Special delivery instruction is required from the account owner for the corporate action outcome to be credited.

IssuerOfferorTaxabilityIndicator.name: Issuer Offeror Taxability Indicator
IssuerOfferorTaxabilityIndicator.definition: Proceeds are taxable according to the information provided by the issuer / offeror.

NewSecuritiesIssuanceIndicator.name: New Securities Issuance Indicator
NewSecuritiesIssuanceIndicator.definition: Specifies the nature of the securities issue.

IncomeType.name: Income Type
IncomeType.definition: Specifies the type of income.|The lists of income type codes to be used, are available on the SMPG website at www.smpg.info.

OtherIncomeType.name: Other Income Type
OtherIncomeType.definition: Type of income to be used under another tax regime.

ExemptionType.name: Exemption Type
ExemptionType.definition: Specifies the basis for the reduced rate of withholding.

EntitledQuantity.name: Entitled Quantity
EntitledQuantity.definition: Quantity of securities based on the terms of the corporate action event and balance of underlying securities entitled to the account owner. (This quantity can be positive or negative).

SafekeepingPlace.name: Safekeeping Place
SafekeepingPlace.definition: Location where the financial instruments are/will be safekept.

CountryOfIncomeSource.name: Country Of Income Source
CountryOfIncomeSource.definition: Indicates the country from which the income originates.

FractionDisposition.name: Fraction Disposition
FractionDisposition.definition: Specifies how fractions resulting from derived securities will be processed or how prorated decisions will be rounding, if provided with a pro ration rate.

CurrencyOption.name: Currency Option
CurrencyOption.definition: Currency in which cash proceeds are to be credited/debited.

TradingPeriod.name: Trading Period
TradingPeriod.definition: Period during which intermediate or outturn securities are tradable in a secondary market.

DateDetails.name: Date Details
DateDetails.definition: Provides information about the dates related to securities movement.

RateDetails.name: Rate Details
RateDetails.definition: Provides information about the rates related to securities movement.

PriceDetails.name: Price Details
PriceDetails.definition: Provides information about the prices related to securities movement.

AmountDetails.name: Amount Details
AmountDetails.definition: Provides information about the amounts related to a securities movement.

IssuerOfferorTaxabilityIndicatorUsageRul.definition: The IssuerOfferorTaxabilityIndicator may only be used when no tax rate is provided in the message and it must not be used in events such as dividend or interest.|The list of proprietary IssuerOfferorTaxabilityIndicator codes that may be used are provided in the document " TXAP Taxability Codes" available on the SMPG website at www.smpg.info.

IncomeTypeUsageRule.definition: The lists of income type codes to be used in IncomeType are provided in the document "ETYP-ITYP Exemption & Income Type Codes" available on the SMPG website at www.smpg.info.

ExemptionTypeUsageRule.definition: The lists of exemption type codes to be used in ExemptionType are provided in the document "ETYP-ITYP Exemption & Income Type Codes" available on the SMPG website at www.smpg.info.

IncomeType1Rule.definition: If at least one occurrence of OtherIncomeType is present, then IncomeType must be present.
